passage: Friday night. I have been so stressed about the stream form that I could not eat. Today I finally went to see Shreya Ma'am, the counsellor, and she told me two things I did not know: some schools let you change stream after Class 11, and many careers accept more than one route. My shoulders came down about an inch. So I do not have to get this perfect. I only have to get it good enough, and check. I chose Commerce with Maths because it fits me best right now. In my planner I wrote in red: "Review after first term." If it feels wrong, I will look at the options again with Shreya Ma'am. Nikita

How did Nikita feel after talking to Shreya Ma'am?
qa.a: Relieved, since Nikita's shoulders came down and the pressure eased. 😊

qa.q: What could Nikita do at the review if the stream feels wrong?
qa.a: Look at the options again with the counsellor and check what the school allows, because a change is possible only where a school permits it.

qa.q: How might Shreya Ma'am see Nikita's worry?
qa.a: As a common worry that needs information, since the counsellor gave facts that lowered the pressure.

grounding: Told that a stream change after Class 11 is possible at some schools, Nikita relaxes, chooses the best current fit and sets a review after the first term.
